segments.subtask: The robot arm approaches the green mat with food items and a blue-handled tool.
The robot arm grasps the blue-handled tool with its right gripper.
The robot arm lifts the blue-handled tool from the green mat.
The robot arm moves the blue-handled tool towards the right basket.
The robot arm places the blue-handled tool into the right basket.
The robot arm moves back to the green mat to grasp the food item.
The robot arm grasps the food item with its right gripper.
The robot arm lifts the food item from the green mat.
The robot arm moves the food item towards the right basket.
The robot arm places the food item into the right basket.
The robot arm moves back to the green mat to grasp the non-food item.
The robot arm grasps the non-food item with its left gripper.
The robot arm lifts the non-food item from the green mat.
The robot arm moves the non-food item towards the left basket.
